transcript.text: In the next duel set, guys, we were up
against Reuben here and Reuben is a very
good player, guys. Reuben is a world
champion from 2020, world finalist from
2021, 2023, just like a very well-known
player. You guys probably know him. I
don't even know why I'm explaining who
he is, but first off, in the first match
here against Reuben, I had a a mortar
bait deck. And here, I was kind of
expecting him to maybe go for a bridge
bam type of deck. So, I thought that,
you know, a mortar bowler deck could be
a pretty good pick and a comfort deck as
well. One thing that I do try to, you
know, do in these types of tournaments
is I try to be, you know, as comfortable
as possible with my decks. Here he go
for RG Skelly Drags. Really aggressive.
So, I went for my mortar plus rascals on
defense. I actually don't know why he
did that cuz since his RG isn't EVO, it
doesn't actually do anything to go for
those early game RGs. I guess he just
didn't know what I had and he didn't
want to do a naked RG, which I get that.
I guess maybe he thought I had minions
or something and I could instantly
minions on the RG. And if that was true,
then he probably would have won right
away to be honest. So, I guess thinking
about it now, that was probably a pretty
good play. So, here I went for the
bowler ability because I do know that in
this matchup, the only thing that gives
him trouble is the bowler. So, I went
for the quick skellies here to make
that, you know, jump and then my bowler
got both the skellies because of that.
And since that happened, my bowler got
two shots on the tower. So, that was a
500 damage play for me right there. I I
always try to finesse people with the
quick spirits cuz people do always use
the spirits to, you know, outrun the
bowler throws and then fully counter it.
So, if you can quickly drop your spirit
or something like that, then you can
quickly get a lock on the tower, which
is great. So, that 500 damage, guys, is
going to show that it was very important
to me cuz in my deck, I don't have a
minor. I don't have like a direct source
of damage. I only have skelly barrel and
mortar, which are both good, of course,
but they're no like minor or anything
like that. They're not like a hog rider
where you can comfortably always get
them to the tower. So, here I went for
the skelly barrel cuz he had no goblin
cage in hand and goblin cage does fully
shut me down every time. I had the
fireball ready for the skelly drags, but
thankfully for me, he does actually let
that connect, which is going to be nice
from him. One problem that I did think
about in this match. I'm like, dude, I
can't really stop him from getting
fireball value on my tower cuz I have to
rascals near my tower, right, every
single time. And then at the same time,
on top of that, I also have to like put
my mortars near the tower. I have to put
my dark goblins near the tower. So, he's
always going to be fireball cycling me
out, which was scary because I know that
he has a way quicker cycle than me. So,
if I get spell cycle, then I do pretty
much just Lucu here. I went for the
rascals plus skellies here knowing that
I was going to take at least one shot,
but I did get a bowler roll, so it kind
of made up for it. Then, I went for the
Evo skelly barrel at the bridge, just
trying to keep up the pressure and stuff
like that. I went for a barbarian barrel
as well, just so there would be more
skellies on the map when the skelly
barrel explodes so the firecracker
doesn't go over there. And then I just
set up another defensive mortar. you you
guys can see I'm playing a ton of
defense in this matchup just because of
how strong his defense actually is and
he can just fireball cycle me. So I have
to be making sure that I'm applying
pressure to the point where he doesn't
feel comfortable with going for spell
cycling. So then I went for the rascals
up top trying to space them out from the
fireball which I actually did very well
and and I got a skelly barrel death bomb
on the tower as well. So I was feeling
okay right now but I was kind of worried
about the second RG but since I had
another mortar in cycle I wasn't like
super scared. I went for the mortar
right here and then I went for the
bowler as well just to make sure that I
could take out the firecracker. I lined
it up pretty well right there and then
my skellies were putting in work as
well. So I was kind of making like a
brick wall on defense, but I knew at any
point he could just switch to spell
cycling and I lose there. I had the
bowler ability just to get the
firecracker off the board. And then I
grabbed my free fireball on the tower as
well cuz if I ever get a chance to
fireball, I do need to be taking it
since
I don't think that, you know, I could
have got many other opportunities to
spell cycle the tower here. I had a
feeling he was going to RG the bridge,
but surprisingly he actually didn't RG
the bridge. I really thought it was
coming, but then he went for the RG in
the back. I'm like, okay, that's fine
with me. But the thing is going RG the
back against a bowler in triple elixir
maybe isn't always the move because then
I just get a free bowler and my bowler
will obviously live and right now I was
just trying to make sure that my you
know bowler didn't get splashed by that
firecracker. I did have to fireball here
which was good by him. So now he is you
know one fireball closer cuz he got a
fireball on my tower and I had to
fireball on defense
which is never all that good. So here I
wanted to keep up the pressure. He
fireballled me again, but then I noticed
I'm like, "Wait, I'm up a fireball cuz
we both only have fireball and barbarian
barrel. So, he needs more damage or else
I'm just going to win." So, I take my
opportunity to fireball his tower here
after he fireballs mine. And I'm like,
"Well, we're both going to get a
fireball down." So, I win the game as
long as he doesn't get any firecracker
chip. I see his firecracker come down in
here. Honestly, I wasn't taking any
risks, man. I damn near morted at the
bridge so the firecracker couldn't
splash me, bro. I was not taking that
risk, guys. And I win the game by 52 HP.
I do secure the win and against Reuben,
I am 1 and0 in the second dual set.
So guys, in the next match here, I had
this Goblin Drill deck, and this was the
